crossRefs.note: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted…
I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
“But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is…
None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done…
Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and…
Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall…
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk…
Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may…
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly…
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…

translations.web: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
translations.bsb: “Collect no more than you are authorized,” he answered.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Extort no more than that which is appointed you.
